title: Keep It Local — Asset
description: A physical or digital item that provides or stores capability: hardware, software, model, dataset, facility, or facility component. See models/infrastructure-data-model.md.

kind.description: What kind of thing the asset is.

ownedBy.description: Organization id (see infrastructure.schema.json) that owns the asset.

operatedBy.description: Organization id that operates the asset.

locatedAt.description: Location id (see infrastructure.schema.json) where the asset is physically located.

description.description: Free-text description of the asset and its purpose.

evidenceId.description: Evidence id (see evidence.schema.json) supporting this record.
